subject: [RFC PATCH 40/57] mm/collapse: remove the tracepoints of the mechanism that is gone

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch removes four tracepoints that were no longer needed after the anonymous memory mechanism was deleted. The removed tracepoints are mm_khugepaged_scan_pmd, mm_collapse_huge_page, mm_collapse_huge_page_isolate, and mm_collapse_huge_page_swapin. These tracepoints had lost their only emitter and were no longer useful. The patch also removes two entries from the raw_tp_null_args[] array that could never match again. The engine's own events now cover the same ground as these removed tracepoints.
